Job-Description:
## Job title
Airline pilots, copilots, and flight engineers 

## Job Summary
We're seeking a professional and experienced individual to join our team as an airline pilot, copilot, or flight engineer. Our perfect candidate will have substantial experience in the air and at sea, possessing remarkable knowledge in navigation and mechanics, and outstanding teamwork, communication, and leadership skills. 

## Required Skills
- Exceptional navigation skills to chart optimal path routes and consider factors like weather conditions.
- Proven leadership and management skills to coordinate with the airline staff and lead effectively for smooth operation.
- Solid mechanical knowledge to understand and quickly resolve any aircraft malfunction.
- Outstanding communication skills to communicate effectively with crew members and ground control effectively.

## Required Experience
- Previous employment in particular positions such as airline pilots, copilots and flight engineers for minimum 3 years.
- Prior working experience minimum of 3 years as ship or boats captains and operators.

## Responsibilities
- Coordinating with ground control to decide on the best travel routes.
- Checking and maintaining aircraft systems before, during, and after the flight.
- Provision of optimal customer service and safety for all the passengers.
- Leading airline crewmembers in emergency situations and diversion conditions.
